caption: The drawing features a large, dark brown, bowl-shaped object positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background. The object has a smooth surface, rounded bottom, and slightly squared-off rim, with a small protruding rectangular tab on the lower left side. Off to the lower left of the main object, there is a scaled-down, overlapped series of three similarly shaped bowls, depicted in a faint, almost translucent grey, placed next to the outline of a human figure for scale reference. The human figure is simple and uncolored, standing upright and facing slightly to the right. Near the lower right corner of the image, the name "STANLEY MAZUR" is typed in small, neat, uppercase letters. The overall composition is minimal and emphasizes the shape, scale, and proportions of the primary bowl-like object in relation to a human.
title: Soup Kettle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
